answer: Opening a challenge burns a deposit of 89 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. Because the crystal deposit is held in the nebula escrow, the vine audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases thus burns capital on every one it does not finish. The fee repeats 14 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
